newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Parana state to sell 8.27 pct of Copel.
newsitem.headline: Parana state to sell 8.27 pct of Copel.

text.p: Brazil's Parana state government on Friday will sell its 8.27 percent preferred stake in state-owned power distributor Copel, Copel said in a statement published in local newspapers.
The state government will offer eight billion Copel preferred "B" shares at an auction on the Rio de Janeiro stock exchange at 1330 local/1530 gmt, it said.
The minimum price for the eight billion preferred shares was set at nine reais per lot of 1,000 shares, the statement said.
Banks Banestado, Bozano, Simonsen, Banco Votorantim, Merrill Lynch, Deutsche Morgan Grenfell, BBA, ING Barings and Omega will coordinate the sale, it said.
